name: HELL ON FIRE
author: xvia
description: Release early at 30.8% to fall slightly below the gameplay between the spike and cube portal right before your icon becomes cube. Move back up into the level at 31.5% and then spam through the gameplay as the mini wave until 34.6% where you can hold above the level through the yellow orb between the spikes and saw. Stay above the gameplay until the end from there.
